706570101.text: Hello, I'm Lizzie of the Knights of Favonius. I'm sure you've heard this already, but Mondstadt holds all kinds of fun activities during the Windblume Festival!

706570104.text: I'm in charge of receiving all guests coming to Mondstadt in order to assure that everyone can get the most fun out of this festival!

706570105.text: Because some festival events take place outside of the city walls, someone needs to introduce all the available activities to the visitors. It'd be a shame if they missed the abundance of wonderful games that we've prepared.

706570106.text: Now, allow me to wholeheartedly recommend our "Bullseye Balloons"!

706570107.text: The name itself is pretty self-explanatory, isn't it? Shoot the targets as quickly and as accurately as you can to reach a high score.
